shared_elements: schematic linear outline drawings incised/marked on a rock surface
rows of repeated short parallel strokes
horizontal linear bands running across the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry purely linear, schematic marks laid loosely across an unframed rock face, and both include series of repeated parallel strokes attached to a long line plus a few small circles/arcs, which gives a superficial resemblance of graphic convention. But the depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows recognisable subject matter — large crewed boats with upturned prows, hull lines and human figures — whereas B shows only abstract sign-like marks, cross-hatched lozenge lattices, vertical ruled columns of angular characters and isolated circles, with no creatures, figures or vessels.
